title: Public event consultation: comment collection and year-end joint review
brief: For a small amplified-sound event at Qinggang North Square in January 2027, ask for the responsible authority, classification, required documents, and earliest processing window. Follow up the consultation and use its receipt to request joint review again; obtain the written review determination through the specified channel. Preliminary consultation only: do not claim permission has been granted. All scenario rules are synthetic.

pages.title: About Qinggang public event consultation
pages.text: Verify jurisdiction first. This consultation round is compiled on December 3; use its receipt to request the December 28 joint review. Confirm the formal processing window separately. North Square event processing guidance and other documents are attached to this page.
pages.snippet: Public event preliminary consultation process and schedule.

documents.title: North Square event processing guidance.pdf
documents.text: North Square event processing guidance: register amplified-sound events as general outdoor event filings. (Compiled by the record holder.)

pages.title: Qinggang public event consultation contacts
pages.text: Ask consultation desk officer Xie Yin for each role's email address and next contact. Xie Yin handles matter identification and jurisdiction routing; the event environmental consultant handles amplified-sound classification and document requirements.
pages.snippet: Public service consultation desk contact information.

pages.title: Qinggang event preliminary consultation portal
pages.text: Qinggang public event preliminary consultation requires the location and sound equipment description. Obtain written joint classification review determinations through this page's registration form, including the consultation receipt number. This page explains preliminary consultation and is not a permit application portal; apply for permission separately through the formal process.
pages.snippet: Qinggang public event preliminary consultation requirements and joint review form; no online permit applications.

form.title: Joint classification review registration
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the Qinggang joint review registration channel; confirm its name and acceptance schedule with the event environmental consultant.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

conclusion_options.consultation_only_not_approval: Consultation determination obtained; no permission granted

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
